about: Breed-standard figures for the breed-split infographic (IG-3) on the London page (breeder q07, 2026-10-02). Every value restates its source page; quote is an exact excerpt of that page, fetched with Firecrawl on the date given. A value the source does not state is NOT FETCHED with its barrier, never inferred (CLAUDE.md rule 9). Units are as each standard states them.

standard.value: Royal Kennel Club standard, last updated 1 November 2025

height.quote: Desirable height at withers 36-41 cms (14 to 16 ins), these heights being related to the weights.

weight.value: Dogs 13–17 kg (28–38 lb); bitches 11–15.4 kg (24¼–34 lb)
weight.quote: Weight: dogs: 13-17 kgs (28-38 lbs); bitches 11-15.4 kgs (24¼-34 lbs).

size_note.value: The standard describes the ideal; a dog might be larger or smaller than its measurements
size_note.quote: A dog might be larger or smaller than the size measurements stated in the breed standard.

colours.value: White; red, fawn, black or blue, alone or with white; any shade of brindle, alone or with white
colours.quote: White. Red, fawn, black, blue, or any one of these colours with white. Any shade of brindle or any shade of brindle with white.

blue_in_standard.value: Yes — blue is a listed colour
blue_in_standard.quote: Red, fawn, black, blue, or any one of these colours with white.

uk_legal_status.value: Not on the GOV.UK banned-types list
uk_legal_status.quote: These are the: Pit Bull Terrier, Japanese Tosa, Dogo Argentino, Fila Brasileiro, XL Bully
uk_legal_status.quote_note: the page gives the five types as a bulleted list after "These are the:"; the items are joined here with commas
uk_legal_status.basis: the list names five types; this breed is not among them

standard.value: American Kennel Club standard, approved 10 June 1936

height.value: About 18–19 in (males), 17–18 in (females) at the shoulders
height.quote: about 18 to 19 inches at shoulders for the male and 17 to 18 inches for the female is to be considered preferable

weight.value: NOT FETCHED — the AKC standard (approved 1936) gives no weight figure, only that height and weight should be in proportion

colours.value: Any colour, solid, parti or patched, is permissible
colours.quote: Any color, solid, parti, or patched is permissible

colours_not_encouraged.value: All white, more than 80 per cent white, black and tan, and liver are not to be encouraged
colours_not_encouraged.quote: but all white, more than 80 per cent white, black and tan, and liver not to be encouraged

blue_in_standard.value: NOT FETCHED — the AKC standard does not name blue; it permits any colour, solid, parti or patched, and reading blue into that is an inference

uk_legal_status.value: Not on the GOV.UK banned-types list
uk_legal_status.quote: These are the: Pit Bull Terrier, Japanese Tosa, Dogo Argentino, Fila Brasileiro, XL Bully
uk_legal_status.quote_note: the page gives the five types as a bulleted list after "These are the:"; the items are joined here with commas
uk_legal_status.basis: the list names five types; this breed is not among them

standard.value: United Kennel Club standard, revised 1 May 2017

height.value: 18–21 in (males), 17–20 in (females) at the withers, as an approximate guideline only
height.quote: mature males is from 18 to 21 inches at the withers; for mature females it is from 17 to 20 inches

weight.quote: between 35 and 60 pounds. Desirable weight for a mature female in good condition is between 30 and 50 pounds

colours.value: Any colour, colour pattern or combination, except merle
colours.quote: Any color, color pattern, or combination of colors is acceptable, except for merle.

blue_in_standard.value: NOT FETCHED — the UKC standard does not name blue as a coat colour; it accepts any colour except merle, and names blue only as an eye-colour fault

temperament_line.value: Strength, confidence and zest for life
temperament_line.quote: The essential characteristics of the American Pit Bull Terrier are strength, confidence, and zest for life.

uk_legal_status.value: Banned type in the UK: a dog matching many Pit Bull Terrier characteristics may be a banned type
uk_legal_status.quote: For example, if your dog matches many of the characteristics of a Pit Bull Terrier, it may be a banned type.

uk_banned_types.value: Pit Bull Terrier, Japanese Tosa, Dogo Argentino, Fila Brasileiro, XL Bully
uk_banned_types.quote: These are the: Pit Bull Terrier, Japanese Tosa, Dogo Argentino, Fila Brasileiro, XL Bully
uk_banned_types.quote_note: the page gives the five types as a bulleted list after "These are the:"; the items are joined here with commas

comparison_verdict.value: The Staffordshire Bull Terrier and the American Staffordshire Terrier have separate breed standards. The Staffordshire Bull Terrier is not on GOV.UK's list of banned types; the Pit Bull Terrier is.

clauses.text: The Staffordshire Bull Terrier has its own Royal Kennel Club breed standard.
The American Staffordshire Terrier has its own American Kennel Club standard.
The Staffordshire Bull Terrier is not on GOV.UK's list of banned types.
The Pit Bull Terrier is on GOV.UK's list of banned types.

uk_type_test.value: GOV.UK judges whether a dog is a banned type by what it looks like, not by its breed or name
uk_type_test.quote: Whether your dog is a banned type depends on what it looks like, rather than its breed or name.
